newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mixed.

text.p: Cash bids for spring wheat were mixed on Friday amid sporadic movement, several dealers said.
MGE wheat futures also ended mixed with March up 1-1/2 cents at $4.24-1/2 a bushel.
"We had a little movement" but demand was light for spring wheat, a Minnesota dealer said.
When the cash market reached $4.10 a bushel, some farmers opted to sell their spring wheat, a Montana dealer said.
In the Pacific Northwest, farm selling was limited and activiy was subdued, several dealers said.
